  <path class="color2" style="fill:#ffffff; pointer-events:none;" d="M281.75,263.75c5.4,0,9,3.6,9,9s-3.6,9-9,9h-126c-5.4,0-9-3.6-9-9s3.6-9,9-9Zm0-108c5.4,0,9,3.6,9,9s-3.6,9-9,9h-126c-5.4,0-9-3.6-9-9s3.6-9,9-9Zm0,54c5.4,0,9,3.6,9,9s-3.6,9-9,9h-126c-5.4,0-9-3.6-9-9s3.6-9,9-9Z"/>
</svg>

<style>

  .pulse-index {
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    fill:#e0e2eb;
    opacity:0.8;
    animation: pulse-index 3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.4,1) infinite;
  }

  .pulse-index-button {
    fill:#696b74;
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  }

  .pulse-index-button:hover {
    transform:scale(1.25);
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
  }

  .pulse-index-button:active {
    transform:scale(0.9);
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    transition: transform 0.1s;
  }

  @keyframes pulse-index {
    0%,100% {
      transform:scale(1);
    }
    50% {
      transform:scale(0.9);
    }
  }

</style>
